desc: The new WARSCORP9 from Wraithworks is a USA-made AR-9 that accepts Scorpion Evo 9mm magazines! The WARSCORP9 features a machined billet upper and lower receiver as well as a 6061 T-6 7″ M-LOK handguard. The WARSCORP9 is compatible with standard AR-15 barrels, trigger groups, handguards, furniture, and modified bolt carriers. The lower receiver is fully ambidextrous which includes an ambi safety, ambi bolt catch levers, and even ambi magazine release buttons and paddle release. The paddle will release the magazine and pressing the magazine button on either side of the lower receiver will also activate the paddle release and release the magazine. Controls will be extremely familiar to anyone who has used an AR-15, and the controls are designed to be reached and operated by the pistol grip hand. The 1:10 twist 8.5” Nitride coated 9mm barrel with 1/2×28 threads is complemented by a Wraithworks custom 9mm muzzle device. The operating system is rounded out with a nitrided bolt, 9mm buffer and mil-spec carbine length receiver extension with an installed SB Tactical SBA3 adjustable pistol brace. The Wraithworks WARSCORP9 pistol weighs in at 5lbs 8oz unloaded and has a usable length of 24″ with the adjustable pistol brace collapsed and 26.5″ with the adjustable pistol brace fully extended. Aluminum components are anodized in a durable Mil-Spec Type III Class 2 hardcoat. The WARSCORP9 is 100% designed, manufactured, and assembled in the USA.
